paper.title: Regularized Distribution Matching Distillation for One-step Unpaired Image-to-Image Translation
paper.venue: Structured Probabilistic Inference & Generative Modeling workshop of ICML 2024

claims.paper_claim: Theorem 3.1 states that as lambda approaches zero, the theoretical RDMD optimum converges to the quadratic-cost Monge optimal-transport map under mild regularity conditions.
RDMD combines a diffusion-distribution matching KL term with lambda times expected transport cost and optimizes generator and fake diffusion objectives by coordinate descent.
AFHQv2 Cat-to-Wild translation reports the claimed FID and faithfulness trade-off against diffusion baselines.
The 2-D Gaussian-to-8-Gaussian experiment shows a useful lambda=0.2 fidelity/correspondence trade-off.
Appendix A gives a formal soft-to-hard convergence argument supporting asymptotic optimality.
